paper.abstract_en: We construct fully backreacted charged black brane solutions with a spatially disordered chemical potential in asymptotically AdS$_3$ and AdS$_4$, providing holographic duals of strongly coupled disordered systems. At intermediate temperatures these geometries display highly inhomogeneous horizons, though their geometric averages reproduce the clean BTZ and Reissner-Nordström solutions. The low temperature behavior, however, differs sharply between dimensions. In AdS$_3$, inhomogeneities decay and the horizon flows to the clean charged BTZ fixed point, rendering disorder irrelevant in the infrared. In AdS$_4$, horizon inhomogeneities persist: while the averaged geometry flows to the clean AdS$_2\times \mathbb{R}^2$ throat, the disordered horizon induces a finite residual resistivity. These results show that disorder can qualitatively alter the IR physics of holographic metals and indicate violations of the Harris criterion in strongly coupled systems.

decision.abstract_zh: 我们在渐近 AdS$_3$ 和 AdS$_4$ 中构造了具有空间无序化学势的完全 backreacted 带电黑膜解，为强耦合无序系统提供了全息对偶。在中间温度下，这些几何显示出高度非均匀的视界，尽管它们的几何平均再现了干净的 BTZ 和 Reissner-Nordström 解。然而，低温行为在不同维度之间差异显著。在 AdS$_3$ 中，非均匀性衰减，视界流向干净的带电 BTZ 不动点，使得无序在红外中变得无关。在 AdS$_4$ 中，视界非均匀性持续存在：虽然平均几何流向干净的 AdS$_2\times \mathbb{R}^2$ 喉区，但无序视界诱导出有限的剩余电阻率。这些结果表明，无序可以定性地改变全息金属的红外物理，并表明在强耦合系统中违反了 Harris 判据。
